notes: Twenty-five source and thirty-six target tokens partitioned exactly once.
Both articles of בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא are unrepresented because הוּא licenses the ASV's single determiner *that* (rule 41's rider on a determiner another morpheme licenses).

The complementizer *that* (t012) joins the presentative הָיָה frame under rule 45, discontinuous around the temporal phrase and the speech formula; the apodosis opens with no waw, so nothing else can carry it.

לֵב הַמֶּלֶךְ and לֵב הַשָּׂרִים are rendered arthrously on both sides, so the present article takes the *the* before its own word and the construct takes a supplied one (rule 29); nothing is fronted.
